headline: 迈克尔·麦克唐纳就任美国国家人文基金会主席
summary: 国家人文基金会9月24日通讯确认，McDonald在8月获参议院确认后已宣誓就任第13任主席；通讯未列出宣誓日。

sources.title: Michael McDonald Sworn in as NEH Chairman, NEH Announces $41.4 Million for 81 Humanities Projects, Student Art Contest Regional and National Winners
sources.publisher: National Endowment for the Humanities newsletter
sources.excerpt: Following confirmation by the United States Senate in August, Michael McDonald was sworn in as the thirteenth Chairman of the National Endowment for the Humanities.

sources.title: Office of the Chair
sources.excerpt:
Michael McDonald
Chairman, National Endowment for the Humanities
